family: The single total BK/Shoup family defined in proof.md (identical to the starting seed's family): f_0=0; for n>=1 choose the least prime k>2*n^(3/5), r=ceil(n/k), t=ceil(sqrt(r)); fix one deterministic Shoup F_2 irreducible-polynomial algorithm; pad x with zeros into r field blocks, set y_i=phi_i(x)^(2^(i+1)-1), and output the constant coefficient of Sym_r^t(y_1,...,y_r). The fixed algorithm and field basis are as specified in proof.md.
theorem: For this one total uniform polynomial-time family, hence in NP with empty witnesses, C_B2(f_n)>=3n-4*floor(6*n^(4/5))-4 for every sufficiently large integer length n=|x| in the full Li–Yang B2 model, so C_B2(f_n)>=3n-o(n). Proof: the Ben-Sasson–Kopparty affine-disperser property (f_n nonconstant on affine subspaces of dimension >6n^(4/5)) plus a self-contained gate-elimination argument showing any B2 circuit for a function nonconstant on all affine subspaces of dimension >d has at least 3n-4d-4 gates.
